chunks: Sufficient is Allah and His Word as perfection.

There is no god but Allah, alone, without partner; to Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs the praise; He gives life and causes death, and He is the Ever-Living who does not die; in His hand is all good, and He is over all things competent.

key_terms.بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ: In His hand is all good
key_terms.يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ: He gives life and causes death

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the concluding declaration of faith in Kamal al-Din?
ai.summary: This declaration, prominently featured in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Kamal al-Din*, serves as a foundational creedal summary that underscores the Ismaili and Ja'fari emphasis on Allah’s absolute sovereignty (Tawhid) and eternal nature. It reflects the scholarly tradition of using concise, authoritative formulas to encapsulate core theological tenets, reinforcing the believer's conviction in divine unity as the basis for all religious practice.
